🥯 ComfyUI 的 BAGEL 工作流程 – 一体化图像生成、编辑和视觉推理

这是一个完整的 ComfyUI 工作流程，由百吉饼（Blip-Aware Generator 增强逻辑），结合文本到图像, 图像编辑（修复）, 和视觉问答（VQA）使用 BLIP2 和 Vicuna。非常适合希望在一个简化的管道中进行生成+推理的高级人工智能创建者。

🚀 主要特点：

  • 📷 文本到图像的生成具有语言感知细节

  • 🛠️ 图像编辑和修复精确控制

  • 💬 视觉问答 (VQA)通过 BLIP2 + 骆驼毛 7B/13B

  • 🔄 预构建和优化的 ComfyUI 工作流程 — 无需手动设置

🔧 VRAM 和硬件要求：

  • ❗ 最小显存：16GB（BLIP2 + Vicuna 是内存密集型）

  • 💻 推荐：24GB+（例如RTX 3090/4090或A6000）以获得稳定的性能

  • ⚠️ 不适合低 VRAM 系统 — Vicuna 模型很大并且需要大量资源

  • 🧠 可选地运行得更好exllama 或 exllamav2加载器（如果使用量化模型）

🥯 BAGEL Workflow for ComfyUI – All-in-One Image Generation, Editing & Visual Reasoning

This is a complete ComfyUI workflow powered byBAGEL(Blip-Aware Generator Enhanced with Logic), combiningtext-to-image, image editing (inpainting), andvisual question answering (VQA)using BLIP2 and Vicuna. Ideal for advanced AI creators who want generation + reasoning in one streamlined pipeline.

🚀 Key Features:

  • 📷 Text-to-Image Generationwith language-aware detail

  • 🛠️ Image Editing & Inpaintingwith precise control

  • 💬 Visual Question Answering (VQA)via BLIP2 + Vicuna 7B/13B

  • 🔄 Pre-built and optimized ComfyUI workflow — no manual setup needed

🔧 VRAM & Hardware Requirements:

  • ❗ Minimum VRAM: 16GB (BLIP2 + Vicuna are memory-intensive)

  • 💻 Recommended: 24GB+ (e.g., RTX 3090/4090 or A6000) for stable performance

  • ⚠️ Not suitable for low-VRAM systems — Vicuna models are large and require significant resources

  • 🧠 Optionally runs better withexllama or exllamav2loaders if using quantized models
